---
name: Feature request
about: Describe a concrete optimization workload or missing capability.
---

## Problem or workload

What are you trying to do, and what limitation do you encounter? Include a small
example or representative problem dimensions if possible.

## Proposed change

Describe the behavior that would help and how you would judge success.

## Existing options

Describe approaches you tried and why they do not meet the requirement. Include
relevant correctness or performance evidence when available.
